bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for additional Metro Transit Police officers.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; METRO TRANSIT POLICE.

$7,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $7,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Metropolitan Council for staff and equipment costs of additional sworn officers for the Metro Transit Police Department.
additions: $7,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $7,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Metropolitan Council for staff and equipment costs of additional sworn officers for the Metro Transit Police Department.
